items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: Well, she was working in the show with us in Grand Terrace in Chicago and we met and that's when we got married.

ctx.x: Yeah, her name was Connie Harris. Well, she was working in the show with us in Grand Terrace in Chicago and we met and that's when we got married. And we're still married.

Then I stayed with them at the Grand Terrace. When we finished the Grand Terrace I left Fletcher and came back to New York. Then when I got back to New York I played at the Savoy with Don Redman and then I played -- had my own band
